ABOUT

/About the organization

World Afro Day® is a global day of change, education and celebration of Afro hair, held every 15 September. It is run by World Afro Day CIC, founded by Michelle De Leon, and works towards Afro hair freedom in every area of life, for every generation.

Its work focuses on Health, Education, Employment and Policy. It has been endorsed by the UN Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights, contributed to EHRC school hair guidance, and been celebrated by Janet Jackson, Viola Davis, Mel B, Beverley Knight and Levi Roots.

In 2025 it set a Guinness World Record. In 2026 it marked the 10th World Afro Day with the 'Fro Festival, a three-day street takeover at Coal Drops Yard, King's Cross, London.

SCOPE

/My role & scope

I worked with World Afro Day twice: part-time from June to November 2025 as Social Media Strategist & Executive Assistant to the Founder, then as a freelance Digital Marketing Assistant through September 2026 for the 10th anniversary. I was the only digital marketing VA supporting Michelle on both.

  • 2025: created and scheduled branded content across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok, including every Instagram post for the 9th World Afro Day
  • 2026: posted the 'Fro Festival "Global Panel" pioneers and high-profile guests, each on their own photo with the 10-years anniversary logo as a watermark
  • 2026: drafted LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram posts in the Founder's voice and published through Meta Business Suite
  • Led social media and outreach communications for the record attempt on 15–16 September 2025
  • Designed the official-attempt posts, FAQ graphics, "how to join" reminders and the record-closing announcement
  • Covered the campaign live and promoted the World Afro Day 2025 livestream
  • Designed graphics and numbered carousel slides in Canva, in the WAD purple and gold brand style
  • Edited reels in CapCut, including the World Record Lesson reel
  • Edited the World Afro Day highlight film for YouTube
  • Coordinated with ambassadors, educators and campaign stakeholders, and prepared ambassador packs
  • Sent Mailchimp newsletters for the campaign
  • Engaged the global community by email and WhatsApp
  • Set up the 10th World Afro Day ad on WAD's Meta ad account, sending people to the 'Fro Festival Eventbrite registration
  • Ran it from 10 to 17 September 2026 on a $30-a-day budget
  • Monitored results: 1,674 landing page views at $0.12 each, with above-average quality and engagement rankings
  • 2025: organized admin workflows, inbox systems and campaign assets, and gave executive assistance to the Founder
  • 2026: built a 3-page Schools Presentation Pack (10th Anniversary Edition) from the Founder's drafts and the Brand Book
  • 2026: reached out to contributors from the WAD Partnerships inbox to complete the 'Fro Festival contact database

Guinness World Record campaign

ChallengeGet people around the world to take World Afro Day's online cultural awareness lesson within 24 hours. ActionI led social media and outreach: official-attempt posts, FAQ and "how to join" graphics, ambassador coordination, Mailchimp newsletters, WhatsApp and email, plus live coverage on the day. ResultWorld Afro Day set the Guinness World Record for the most users to take an online cultural awareness lesson in 24 hours: 1,382 people, 15–16 Sep 2025.
